prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy field-documentation photograph. The frame centers an original adult fictional woman and a constructed-material golem performing one task across a two-world fantasy portal threshold. Her visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. She stands in a rain-dark archive hall beside a complete stone threshold that reveals a snowy ruin. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use a medium-wide eye-level view where one closed threshold boundary is anchored to the physical scene in stone; the near side remains a complete readable local space inside the archive; a materially different far-side space is visible through the same boundary as a snowy ruin beyond. One clay-and-stone golem crosses the threshold plane. One complete humanoid or creature body is assembled from nonliving material with fitted articulated limbs; the same clay stone earth or wood continues across torso limbs and joints through grounded motion; seams fitted blocks packed clay or bindings reveal deliberate construction visibly. As one subject or object crosses the plane with coherent clipping and occlusion during a grounded step, posture contact shadow and displaced material show independent motion across threshold dust. Its hands carry the survey crate; one handled load opened path or moved obstacle proves a completed task inside the archive frame. At the plane, light dust reflection or distortion changes locally at the threshold around the crossing body. Keep both spaces, full golem anatomy, the woman's adult face, and the crate legible together. Cool snow daylight meets warm archive lamplight across wet stone and packed clay.
